<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is located in the [[Workyard]], after building it is placed to a fixed spot next to the [[Well]]. Water Pump generates water slowly over time, which can be taken without needing any energy. Every 10 seconds, one drop of [[Water]] is generated into pump's inventory. Water can be taken out in 10-piece stacks until the inventory is depleted. The internal inventory capacity is 500 and can be accessed by any workbench in the workyard.
